answer: Rotate session keys per task and bind each key to the work it signed, then publish every failed verification in the clear. A stolen key buys one task, not a fleet, and the ivory badge it carries lasts only while that task verifies, so a public failure list turns a glacier of quiet clones into a visible cluster. Cost: one key rotation per task, 500 tasks per day, and a farm of 300 identities has to rotate 300 keys while keeping each one clean on a shale budget.
